en.title: Neon Dust: Erased Horizon
en.premise: I am a diver, scavenging for data scraps in the back alleys. One day, I obtain a secret map leading to a "village that shouldn't exist"—a place completely erased from the corporate logs. Hidden there is a brutal system of sacrifice used to maintain the city's prosperity. Bathed in the rain of despair, I dive into the forbidden coordinates.

zh.title: 霓虹尘埃：被抹消的地平线
zh.premise: 我是一名在小巷中搜寻数据残渣的潜行者。某天，我得到了一张秘密地图，它将引导我前往一个从企业管理日志中被彻底抹除的、“本不该存在的村庄”。在那里，隐藏着维持都市繁荣的残酷祭祀系统。在绝望的雨幕中，我向着禁忌的坐标深潜而去。
